requires: android:canRetrieveWindowContent="true" declared in accessibility service XML configuration
AccessibilityService must be enabled and connected (onServiceConnected)
ensures: Returns root AccessibilityNodeInfo of the active window or null if unavailable
invariants: Active window is the window the user is currently touching or that has input focus

parameters.name: prefetchingStrategy
parameters.description: Bitmask strategy flags (e.g. FLAG_PREFETCH_ANCESTORS, FLAG_PREFETCH_SIBLINGS, FLAG_PREFETCH_DESCENDANTS_HYBRID)

requires: API Level >= 33 (Android 13 Tiramisu)
android:canRetrieveWindowContent="true"
ensures: Reduces IPC rounds by prefetching related nodes in the active window hierarchy

parameters.name: gesture
parameters.description: GestureDescription containing stroke paths and durations

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Optional callback to receive completion or cancellation notifications

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: Handler for callback execution, or null for main thread

requires: API Level >= 24 (Android 7.0 Nougat)
android:canPerformGestures="true" declared in service configuration XML
ensures: Returns true if gesture was accepted for dispatch, false if rejected

parameters.name: displayId
parameters.description: Logical display ID (0 for default display)

parameters.name: executor
parameters.description: Executor on which the callback methods will be executed

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback receiving onSuccess(ScreenshotResult) or onFailure(int errorCode)

requires: API Level >= 30 (Android 11)
android:canTakeScreenshot="true" declared in accessibility service XML meta-data
ensures: Provides HardwareBuffer screenshot wrapped via Bitmap.wrapHardwareBuffer(result.getHardwareBuffer(), result.getColorSpace())

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Action constant (GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK=1, GLOBAL_ACTION_HOME=2, GLOBAL_ACTION_RECENTS=3, GLOBAL_ACTION_NOTIFICATIONS=4, GLOBAL_ACTION_QUICK_SETTINGS=5, GLOBAL_ACTION_POWER_DIALOG=6, GLOBAL_ACTION_LOCK_SCREEN=8, GLOBAL_ACTION_TAKE_SCREENSHOT=9)

requires: API Level >= 16
AccessibilityService connected
ensures: Triggers system navigation actions across the OS

parameters.name: arguments
parameters.description: Optional Bundle arguments such as ACTION_ARGUMENT_SET_TEXT_CHARSEQUENCE

requires: android:canRetrieveWindowContent="true"
AccessibilityNodeInfo must represent an active attached node
ensures: Returns true if node accepted and performed action, false otherwise

requires: Permission com.termux.permission.RUN_COMMAND declared and granted
allow-external-apps=true in ~/.termux/termux.properties
Android 12+ (API 31+): Background start restrictions require explicit ComponentName and compliance with ForegroundService rules
ensures: Executes command within Termux environment and optionally returns stdout/stderr/exitCode

invariants: Must be an absolute path inside Termux prefix (e.g. /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/bash)
Value passed in intent must be String[] (String array)
Defaults to Termux HOME directory if not specified
Boolean extra: true executes without opening a terminal window
Values: '0'=new session, '1'=keep current, '2'=switch existing/create, '3'=fail if exists

requires: On Android 12+ (API 31+), must be created with PendingIntent.FLAG_MUTABLE so Termux can attach result extras
ensures: Receives result extras: stdout, stderr, exitCode, errCode (truncated to 100KB to prevent TransactionTooLargeException)

invariants: Directory where Termux will write output files for large payloads

requires: Internet permission in AndroidManifest if loading web URLs
Hardware acceleration recommended for fluid screen reader rendering
ensures: Exposes virtual accessibility nodes (DOM/ARIA) to TalkBack and Jieshuo

requires: Configured on UI thread via webView.getSettings()

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: True to enable JavaScript execution, required for dynamic ARIA and WebSocket client

requires: Must be called before loading dynamic interactive web apps

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Identifier injected into window object (e.g. window.AndroidBridge)

requires: Methods must have @android.webkit.JavascriptInterface annotation
API Level >= 17 prevents reflection vulnerabilities
invariants: Bridge calls execute on private background WebCore thread

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: JavaScript snippet to execute in WebView context

requires: API Level >= 19 (Android 4.4 KitKat)
Must be invoked on Android UI thread
Must run on background thread or Android Service (never Main UI Thread)

OkHttpClient instance calling client.newWebSocket(request, listener)
aria-live="polite" on dynamic output containers for TalkBack announcements
role="button" and tabindex="0" on clickable interactive custom elements
Explicit aria-label or accessible text on all controls without icon-only ambiguity
